text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(karen, x) ::: Karen will binge-watch x.
Download(karen, x) ::: Karen will download x.
Share(karen, x, lisa) ::: Karen will share x to Lisa.
Premises:
Popular(strangerThings) ::: "Stranger Things" is a popular Netflix show.
∀x (Popular(x) → BingeWatch(karen, x)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(karen, x) ↔ Download(karen, x)) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download(karen, blackMirror) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
Popular(blackMirror) → BingeWatch(karen, blackMirror) ::: If "Black Mirror" is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
Download(karen, blackMirror) ↔ BingeWatch(karen, blackMirror) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she will download it.
Share(karen, blackMirror, lisa) ← BingeWatch(karen, blackMirror) ::: If Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she will share it to Lisa.
Conclusion:
Popular(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
